content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) emphasizes that the A1C test, fasting plasma glucose (FPG) test, and 2-hour plasma glucose (2-h PG) test each measure different aspects of glucose metabolism. The results of these tests can vary depending on the population being tested and individual patient factors. Furthermore, the ADA highlights that the use of different diagnostic thresholds for these tests may identify separate and distinct groups of individuals at risk for diabetes or related complications.
